protocol: One sequential warmed desktop Chromium comparison, PCM delivered at capture speed in 100ms chunks. Four concatenated public LibriSpeech test-clean clips. Both runs retain 15-second windows, 7.5-second overlap and pause commitment. No GPU.
limits: Small comparison, not a new corpus accuracy benchmark.
Order was baseline then batched; first-word timing can include residual warmup effects.
The physical Even host reports one CPU thread; these timings are not iPhone measurements.
Reported inference work below audio duration does not mean words arrive without delay.
